direction.situation: Beside Kasun's small food three-wheeler on a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi has just shown interest in his business. Their new acquaintance grows warmer as he answers without embarrassment.
direction.people: Anudi stands frame left facing Kasun, in a plain cream blouse and muted teal skirt, receptive and curious. Her phone rests in her right hand at waist level; her left hand holds the open umbrella, with her handbag on her left forearm. Kasun stands frame right facing her, in a faded blue short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers, his empty hands at his sides and his business behind him. He feels quietly comfortable with her interest.

flow.text: They stay turned toward each other. Kasun meets Anudi's expectant gaze.

flow.how: friendly and modest, giving a slight nod as he confirms ownership, then settling into unembarrassed ease about the small beginning
flow.listener: Anudi keeps her eyes on him, her eyebrows lifting slightly as her curiosity deepens.

flow.how: after a brief beat, warmly curious rather than probing, inclining her head a fraction toward him to learn how much he manages himself
flow.listener: Kasun watches her attentively, taking her interest seriously without becoming formal.

flow.text: Anudi waits with a small smile, keeping her phone at her waist. Kasun draws a quiet breath, still meeting her eyes.

direction.camera: An eye-level waist-up two-shot from the road side on a 40mm lens holds a steady frame on a tripod, with Anudi left, Kasun right and the food three-wheeler in the right background.
direction.sound: Continuous light rain and distant roadside traffic beneath their natural, friendly-polite voices; no music.
